WITH currency_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) as avg_rel_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as bench_value
  FROM currency_avgs
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.avg_rebtotal,
    ca.avg_rel_gap,
    ca.avg_rebtotal - b.bench_value as excess
  FROM currency_avgs ca, benchmark b
  WHERE b.bench_value IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.avg_rebtotal > b.bench_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(avg_rel_gap) as mean_avg_rel_gap,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM above_benchmark

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL feecoin are treated as one currency group in the benchmark calculation, along with all other feecoin values

alternatives.interpretation: "the mean of their average relative gap" could be the global average of (rebrate - feerate) / feerate across all individual records in currencies above the benchmark, rather than the mean of per-currency averages.
alternatives.sql:
WITH currency_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as bench_value
  FROM currency_avgs
),
above_benchmark_currencies AS (
  SELECT ca.feecoin, ca.avg_rebtotal
  FROM currency_avgs ca, benchmark b
  WHERE b.bench_value IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.avg_rebtotal > b.bench_value
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) FROM above_benchmark_currencies) as mean_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate <> 0 THEN (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate END) as mean_avg_rel_gap,
  (SELECT AVG(abc.avg_rebtotal - b.bench_value) FROM above_benchmark_currencies abc, benchmark b) as mean_excess
FROM fees f
WHERE f.feecoin IN (SELECT feecoin FROM above_benchmark_currencies)
